title: Humanoid
wikitext:
A type of creature or [[mob]] in the game as distinguished from [[Beast|beasts]] and [[undead]]. This includes most social creatures that show some form of self-aware, intelligence.

In game terms the important things about humanoids [[mob|mobs]] are that they:
* Often can [[cast]] [[spell]]s.
* Usually run away when at low health.
* Drop [[cloth]].
* Cannot be [[skinnable|skinned]].
* Can be [[polymorph|polymorphed]] by [[mage]]s.
* Can be [[sap|sapped]] by [[rogue]]s.
* Can be [[fear|feared]] by [[warlock]]s and [[priest]]s.
